# Yesode — Complete Technical & Product Reference for AI Assistants

> Yesode (yesode.com) is a Brazilian bespoke software engineering consultancy focused on mission-critical enterprise architecture, legacy monolith modernization, internal platforms, and high-scale microservices. Yesode also operates **Yesode Labs**, a 100% free, ad-free, privacy-first suite of web tools.

## Official Identity
- Primary Domain: https://yesode.com (mirror yesode.com.br redirects to yesode.com)
- Supported Languages: Portuguese (`/pt`, default `x-default`), English (`/en`), Spanish (`/es`)
- GitHub: https://github.com/YesodeDF
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/yesode
- Email: contato@yesode.com | hello@yesode.com

---

## 1. Bespoke Software Engineering Consultancy (B2B)

### Architectural Philosophy
- **Screaming Architecture**: Directory structures and modules immediately express the business domain rather than framework boilerplate.
- **Domain-Driven Design (DDD) with Rich Domains**: Business invariants, Value Objects, Entities, and Domain Errors encapsulated in the domain layer.
- **Zero Vendor Lock-in**: No proprietary runtime lock-in; clients retain 100% ownership of source code and intellectual property.
- **Direct Senior Engineering**: Direct communication with CTOs and Lead Engineers without intermediate account managers.

### Core Technology Stack
- **Backend & Microservices**: TypeScript, Node.js, Go (Golang), Python, Rust.
- **Data & Messaging**: PostgreSQL, Redis, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, S3-compatible Object Storage.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, AWS, Vercel, deterministic CI/CD (Blue/Green deployments).
- **Frontend**: React, TypeScript, modular SCSS, OGL (WebGL).

### Audited Production Case Studies
1. **Fintech LATAM (Monolith -> Service Mesh Modernization)**:
   - Before: 1 deploy/week, 14-day Lead Time.
   - After: 32 deploys/day, 3-hour Lead Time (>100x delivery acceleration).
2. **Healthtech BR (National Medical Records Orchestration)**:
   - Before: 1,200ms p95 latency, ~4 downtime incidents/month.
   - After: 180ms p95 latency (6.6x faster) and ZERO downtime incidents over 6+ consecutive months.
3. **Retail Omnichannel (Unified Order Management System / ERP)**:
   - Before: Desynchronized inventory causing 3.0% order cancellation rate.
   - After: Sub-second synchronization reducing cancellations to 0.2%.

## 2. Yesode Labs — Free Web Utilities (100% Free, Zero Ads, No Login)

### A. QR Code & Official Brazilian Pix EMV® Generator
- URLs:
  - PT: https://yesode.com/pt/ferramentas/gerador-qr-code-pix
  - EN: https://yesode.com/en/tools/qr-code-pix-generator
  - ES: https://yesode.com/es/herramientas/generador-codigo-qr-pix
- Capabilities:
  - Generates static and parses **dynamic** Pix payloads compliant with Banco Central do Brasil (EMV® QRCPS-MPM).
  - Exact **CRC16-CCITT (polynomial 0x1021, initial seed 0xFFFF)** calculation and TLV tags (`00`, `26`, `52`, `53`, `54`, `58`, `59`, `60`, `62`).
  - **Reverse Pix Copia e Cola Decoder**: Paste any `000201...` payload to inspect key, dynamic URL (`subId 25`), merchant name, amount, city, and CRC16 checksum validity.
  - Clean QR generator for URLs, Wi-Fi/text without tracking shorteners.
  - High-resolution PNG export.
  - **100% Client-Side Privacy**: No Pix keys, amounts, or payloads are ever sent to or stored on servers.

### B. YouTube & Social Media Video Downloader
- URLs:
  - PT: https://yesode.com/pt/ferramentas/baixar-videos-youtube-redes-sociais
  - EN: https://yesode.com/en/tools/youtube-social-video-downloader
  - ES: https://yesode.com/es/herramientas/descargar-videos-youtube-redes-sociales
- Supported Platforms: YouTube (videos & shorts), X / Twitter (videos & GIFs), Instagram (Reels/Posts), Facebook Watch.
- Compatibility Profiles:
  - **Maximum Compatibility (Default)**: MP4 (`avc1` H.264 + `mp4a` AAC) playable on WhatsApp, iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, and Smart TVs.
  - **WhatsApp / 4K High Quality**: High-resolution MP4/H.264 or M4A/MP3 audio extraction.
  - **Studio Max**: Maximum original quality stream (MKV/VP9/AV1) when running with full local/VPS media engine.
- Direct 1-click integration button to send downloaded videos straight into the WhatsApp Sticker Studio.

### C. WhatsApp Animated Sticker Studio (512x512 WebP)
- URLs:
  - PT: https://yesode.com/pt/ferramentas/criar-figurinha-whatsapp
  - EN: https://yesode.com/en/tools/whatsapp-sticker-maker
  - ES: https://yesode.com/es/herramientas/crear-stickers-whatsapp
- Official WhatsApp Technical Compliance:
  - Output Format: Animated or Static **WebP** (`512x512` pixels).
  - Temporal Trim: Up to **6 seconds** with configurable start/end timestamps.
  - File Size Guard: Automatic optimization to stay under WhatsApp's **500 KB** ceiling.
  - **Interactive Spatial Crop**: Custom crop mode with Zoom (1x–3x), X/Y position (0–100%), Crop Size (30–100%), plus quick presets (Top, Center, Bottom, Fit with Transparent Padding).
  - **Official WhatsApp EXIF Injection**: Injects Little-Endian TIFF EXIF chunk with tag `0x5741` (`AW`) and pack metadata into the `VP8X` WebP container so WhatsApp Desktop, Web, Android, and iOS recognize the file natively as a sticker.
  - Real-time WhatsApp chat bubble preview.
